name: The Tax Collector's Prize
description:
Elian finds the eye listed as a confiscated farming implement. Someone wanted the theft to sound harmless.

Search pillager outpost chests. Earn End Remastered's corrupted eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
